name: Exposure Score
summary: The Ensemble's convergence page (Exposure Score). Fuses every specialist's signal into ONE exposure score per asset — KEV+EPSS+VPR+ACR+AES and open-finding SLA aging direct, plus attack path (Fenrir), identity (Identity Inventory: account reuse > other NHI / identity risk), AI (Pythia), EOL (Charon), weak/expiring crypto (Certania+Heimdall), ATT&CK (ATT&CK Mapping) and ownership (Ownership) from tags. Grouped estate / convergence / confidence metrics, an at-a-glance strip and a jump nav; ranks the estate worst-first, surfaces the worst finding from each specialist and where they converge, and turns a remediation play into a projected reduction. Cached on disk per navi.db + weighting and built in the background — for the whole estate or for one tag's assets (a separate cache; switch between them). Priority tagging is gated and recomputed server-side.
